_comment: Reference copy of the tacacs-ui OIDC client merged into the icam 'keycloak-realm' ConfigMap (dcim-realm.json -> .clients). Keycloak runs start-dev with an in-memory DB, so the realm is re-imported from that ConfigMap on every restart; keeping the client here makes it durable. It is a PUBLIC client using PKCE (S256), so there is NO client secret to store. oauth2-proxy authenticates the code exchange with the PKCE verifier (it is given an unused placeholder secret only because oauth2-proxy refuses to start without one).
name: usg-tacacs Operations UI
